heading: 8 ingredients. 1 compounded capsule.
activeIngredientsLabel: Active Ingredients: dutasteride, minoxidil 5mg, D-biotin, vitamin C, methyltetrahydrofolate, vitamin D3, zinc picolinate, and vitamin A, in a compounded liposomal capsule for absorption.

ingredients.name: Dutasteride 0.4mg
ingredients.body: Dual 5-alpha reductase inhibitor potentially reducing DHT by ~90%.* Core active ingredient in HairfectRx.

ingredients.name: Oral Minoxidil 5mg
ingredients.body: May support hair growth by increasing blood flow to hair follicles and extending the anagen (growth) phase of the hair cycle.*

ingredients.name: D-Biotin
ingredients.body: May support keratin production and overall hair health.* One of 6 essential nutrients included in the HairfectRx vitamin complex.

ingredients.name: Vitamin Complex
ingredients.body: D-Biotin, Vitamin C, CA-5 Methyltetrahydrofolate, Vitamin D3, Zinc Picolinate, and Vitamin A support healthy hair from the inside out.*

safety.title: Common side effects
safety.body: Decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, decreased semen volume, breast tenderness or enlargement, mood changes, and minoxidil-related side effects such as fluid retention, dizziness, or unwanted body hair growth.

safety.title: Tell your healthcare provider
safety.body: Share any history of liver disease, prostate conditions, low blood pressure, heart conditions, current prescriptions including alpha blockers, and any plans for blood donation while on dutasteride.

safety.title: Do not use if
safety.body: You are a woman or a child. Dutasteride is a medication for men only. Women who are or may become pregnant should never handle dutasteride-containing medications.

safety.title: Seek medical care
safety.body: Severe allergic reaction (rash, swelling, trouble breathing), persistent breast changes, severe mood changes, dizziness or fainting, rapid heart rate, or signs of high-grade prostate disease.
